title: Pierre Deligne Papers: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Drafts
version: 2026-06-04 Deligne working record: forward papers 001-015, reverse papers 090-080 complete plus paper 079 pages 1-20 partial, and complete correspondence reader lane
description:
Dedicated Deligne record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page is separate from the main corpus so Deligne material can be cited, revised, or reorganized independently.

The top-level files are reader-facing and are intentionally English-first where an English translation is present. Individual English paper PDFs, selected French source/working PDFs, and separate correspondence items are exposed for direct download. Broader reference PDFs and TeX/source artifacts are kept in ZIP files rather than cluttering the front-facing reader list.

Status at a glance. The record now has three visible lanes. [#######---] forward paper stream: source-checked working readers cover papers 001-013 complete, paper 014 through page 30, and paper 015; this is not yet a finished 001-015 critical run. [#########+] reverse paper stream: source-checked working readers cover papers 090 down through 080 complete, plus paper 079 pages 1-20 as an explicit partial reader; paper 079 is not complete yet. [##########] correspondence lane: twelve Deligne letter/correspondence readers are present in English, each paired with a French working/source PDF. Original/reference and provenance material is preserved in ZIP artifacts and older/raw provenance versions. These are working scholarly transcriptions and translation drafts, not proofed critical editions.

Latest update. Promoted the reverse-stream D079 packet from local-only to front-facing partial status: Voevodsky's Lectures on Motivic Cohomology 2000/2001, pages 1-20, with English and French working PDFs and a refreshed 079-090 TeX/scan/QA source ZIP. The source packet records rebuilt TeX diagrams for the displayed square and functor material in the new pages. To remain within Zenodo's 100-file cap, bulky prior-package provenance ZIPs A/B were retired from the current clean version; they remain preserved in previous DOI versions and in the raw/provenance lane.
notes: Latest metadata update adds the reverse-stream Paper 079 pages 1-20 partial reader and refreshed 079-090 source/QA packet while preserving the forward 001-015 and twelve-item correspondence lanes.
